method: Recover absolute contact reactions by projecting the current free Newton increment under the shared M+dt^2 K operator; never apply the virtual increment to poses. Reuse the same contact geometry, aliases and multi-load backend.

unit_tests.analytic_case: two resting rods at capsule clearance, known inward inertial load at both free points; total pressure matches force; stale history discarded; separating state releases pressure; poses unchanged
unit_tests.resting_friction: Nonzero tangential friction at zero closing normal velocity, paired momentum preserved.

limitations: Force recovery is experimental and disabled by default: 120-frame trajectory admission failed.
Earlier frame 56-59 drift disappeared in this experiment, but later frame 111 drift remains.
No render FPS measured; >160 FPS has not been established.
Recording shows current native default physics and GPU hair rendering, not the rejected experimental solver.

body_checks.abdomen: separate actual surface binding check >1e-6 m
body_checks.limits: CPU-computed rendered mesh vertices, not an inspected animation or FPS measurement

demo_recording.simulation: current default native demo, experimental force-pressure path disabled
demo_recording.limits: Offline rendering; sample cadence is not measured runtime FPS.
